# App comparison fixtures

`bmlogger-13.8.4.json` is the current reference, generated by executing original
advertisement, conversion and dew-point methods from bmLogger 13.8.4, installed
from Google Play. A historical 12.04.00 reference produced the same 35 readings.

Payloads are synthetic manufacturer data without the company ID. They contain no
physical device identifiers or proprietary source. `null` represents undefined
dew point. Versions 8, 13, 23, 27, 41, 42, and 43 expose measurements. Versions
10, 100, and 101 are gateway status formats, deliberately excluded from sensor
discovery. Version 22 tests preserve existing library behavior, not an
app-dispatched format.

Original app parsing and independent Python decoding agree on positive/negative/
zero temperature and zero/low/saturated humidity. Legacy pressure uses /10 mbar;
modern pressure uses /100 mbar. Comparison is in native units with zero user
calibration. Physical hardware accuracy is not established by synthetic tests.

`live-proxy.json` contains unique manufacturer payloads observed via
read-only ESPHome raw advertisement subscriptions from seven physical devices
(four v13 and three v23). Expected readings were produced by executing the same
Google Play bmLogger 13.8.4 decoder. MAC addresses, names, timestamps and proxy
credentials are omitted. Temperature/battery values also match the proxy's
independent hardcoded decoders; humidity/dew point are app comparisons. These
are interoperability checks, not calibrated physical-accuracy measurements.
